mapper.select: SELECT transaction_key, transaction_type, transaction_id, member_id, transacted_at, detail, amount, inout_type, balance_after, category_id, category_name, memo, source_name, source_number, installment FROM v_all_transactions WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND YEAR(transacted_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(transacted_at) = #{month} ORDER BY transacted_at DESC, transaction_id DESC
